    "I": ["The Great Gatsby", "Philadelphia", "Dances with Wolves", "Mr Holland's Opus", "Forrest Gump"],

}

CLAIMED_LETTERS = ["B", "J"]

# Check 1: structural integrity of the option set (exact enumeration).

print("CHECK option sizes are all 5:", "CHECK PASS" if sizes_ok else "CHECK FAIL")

# Check 2: the question asks for one option; the submission names two.

print("Claimed letters:", CLAIMED_LETTERS)

# No rating data is given, and none can be sampled offline, so this similarity claim cannot be settled.
shared_B_J = sorted(set(OPTIONS["B"]) & set(OPTIONS["J"]))
print("Titles shared by B and J:", shared_B_J)
print("Shared-title count is membership overlap only, not audience preference.")
print("UNSUPPORTED: no audience-rating or like-rate data is available to rank options by how a group would respond.")
print("CHECK UNKNOWN: the genre, theme, audience, and acclaim criteria are asserted without data.")

# Overall verdict.
print("OVERALL: CHECK FAIL (submission names two options for a single-choice question; similarity claim is UNSUPPORTED)")
